answer: A single Licensed compositor type record with compositors verification does the work of a whole committee: 2-year training, 189 supervised settings, safety exam, annual fees, verified by a stranger. A farm that wants 479 seats must buy 479 tickets at 110 POA each, a 52690 POA outlay for one epoch. Open the karst and you find a clerk, open the ember and you find a bill, open the umber and you find a date. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
